links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified radiology report impressions (readability compared with LLM output)
links.outcome: Readability (average reading grade level of four readability indexes)
links.effect: All four LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4, Bard, Bing) simplified impressions across all three prompts, P < .001; differences between LLMs were found within prompts
links.quote: All four LLMs simplified radiology report impressions across all prompts tested (P < .001).

links.comparator_used: Prompt 1, 'Simplify this radiology report.', with no reading-level or audience instruction
links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM-simplified radiology report impressions
links.effect: Stating the patient context (prompt 2) or a 7th grade level (prompt 3) reduced reading grade level for all models and prompts except prompt 1 to prompt 2 for ChatGPT-4, P < .001
links.quote: Providing the context of being a patient or requesting simplification at the seventh-grade level reduced the reading grade level of output for all models and prompts (except prompt 1 to prompt 2 for ChatGPT-4) (P < .001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint and patient-context prompting for report simplification
